offering_description.value: Provides merchant acquiring and payment processing, B2B payables and embedded banking/payment platforms. Sells to small and mid-sized businesses, software platforms, enterprises and financial institutions. Delivers via proprietary cloud-based payment technology, APIs and a direct and partner sales force.

primary_products.value: payment processing platform; card-issuing and digital wallet solutions; point-of-sale and payment acceptance software; virtual cards and payables automation software

primary_services.value: merchant acquiring and payment processing; B2B accounts payable and payment services; embedded banking and payout services; commercial payment and cash-flow services; ISV and partner payment enablement

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized merchants, software platforms, enterprises, financial institutions, marketplaces; B2G: some government and public sector payment acceptance

end_markets.value: retail; restaurants; healthcare; business services; software platforms; financial services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: processing fees and interchange-based discount revenue on card and electronic payment volume; service fees: payables, payout, banking and card issuing program fees; subscription: software and platform fees from merchants and partners; product sales: payment terminals and hardware
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; subscription; product sales

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: acquires and processes payments between merchants, card networks and banks, serving businesses; software / platform: cloud payment, payables and embedded banking platforms sold to ISVs, merchants and enterprises

geography_served.value: North America: primarily United States, with Canada and some international coverage

specialization.value: related lines: merchant solutions, B2B payments, and enterprise/embedded banking solutions sharing payments technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales force to merchants and enterprises; partners / resellers: ISVs, independent sales organizations and referral partners; agents / brokers: independent sales agents and ISOs
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: money transmission, payment processing and card issuing, card network rules, PCI DSS, bank sponsor rules, state licenses, CFPB and FinCEN/AML
